task: JSON Schema 2020-12 subset validator (ae.schema) over plain Java values with exact decimal arithmetic, $ref pointers, unevaluated* annotations and deterministic violations
reasoning_summary: Tests were written first: table-driven keyword cases, exact pointer/order assertions, 58 malformed-schema cases, and randomized metamorphic identities. Annotations are returned per schema object and merged only from valid in-place subschemas, which gives unevaluated* the right semantics. A hand mutation pass (about 50 mutants) found redundant code and missing tests, which were fixed.
